reject.why: the enforcement enum must not gain an 'off' member
the detector list must stay typed as non-empty
injectShim must stay typed as the literal true
an exemption must carry a reason a person can read later
an exemption must expire in the future
an exemption must not outlive the 30-day cap
no more than three exemptions may be active at once
page size must stay inside its declared bounds
automatic loads must stay inside their declared bounds
shim interception flags must stay booleans
definitions stay closed, so no field can be smuggled into the attention policy
every referenced package must be an installed app
app entries are keyed, so packages must be unique
a notification rule must constrain at least one field
a page must respect the config's own maxItemsPerPage
a session budget cannot exceed its daily budget
only the declared apiVersion is accepted
definitions stay closed everywhere, not only under attention

accept.why: the shipped default must always validate
a justified, expiring, single-app exemption is the strongest permitted escape
exactly the cap is allowed; one more is not
